purpose: Prove the walker descends SAME-ORIGIN iframes and stamps each captured control with a frame_selector that resolves back to the owning frame the same way page.frameLocator() would.
targeted_defect: BUG-IFRAME-SELECTOR: frameSelectorFor() interpolates the iframe's id/name/title/src into a CSS selector with NO escaping (inventory_js.py:546-557), while the sibling label[for] lookup 12 lines up correctly uses CSS.escape. An id containing a metacharacter or a name containing a quote yields a selector that is wrong or unparseable, so every control in that frame is recorded against a frame that cannot be re-bound.

frame_selector_recipe.why: frameSelectorFor() is a five-rung fallback chain (id -> name -> title -> src -> positional). Every rung is exercised here, because the two DEFECTIVE rungs sit in the middle of it and a fixture covering only the first would report the recipe healthy.
